title: Qualify finite Euclidean 2D/3D norm distance and projection outcomes
commitMessage: feat: qualify finite Euclidean geometry norm distance and projection contracts

contribution.summary: Qualify bounded finite 2D/3D Euclidean norm, distance and projection with a compiled missing-API RED, 24 GREEN, 326 retained scientific tests, four Math regressions and two SHA-matched isolated preview.5 NuGet consumers. Close only S01-T1 R/G/V and T1; retain S01-T2, S01, S02/S03, C03 and M6 gates. RS093 retry 1 corrects a pre-attempt DWF refusal: both committed request.json and pendingRun=RS093 were present; no attempt was allocated.
contribution.value: Expose typed nonpartial bounded binary64 geometry outcomes with dimension, finite-coordinate, zero-axis, large-coordinate and cancellation refusal statuses. State caller-owned Cartesian units and frame, scaling budgets, no exact or guaranteed rounding-error result, and avoid unqualified geodesic or downstream agent adoption.
debtChanges: Observe a genuinely compiled reflection-based missing public geometry API RED before staging the implementation; a compiler failure is not RED evidence.
Qualify 24 independent GREEN assertions for norm(3,4)=5, origin distance=5, projection onto x=(3,0), selected 3D, scale and typed refusal cases.
Keep finite Cartesian dimensions 2/3 and caller-managed coordinate units; reject nonfinite inputs and projection zero axis without partial numerical outputs.
Declare magnitude <=1e100 and projection-axis maximum >=1e-100 as conservative numeric budgets; do not advertise error bounds or geodesic meaning.
Retain 88 C02-T2, 80 C02-T1, 88 C01-T2 and 70 C01-T1 tests plus four relevant independent Math regression projects.
Produce an actual local 1.1.0-preview.5 scientific package without overwriting qualified preview.4; inspect its contents and SHA-256 bytes.
Verify eight independent NuGet geometry probes and eight retained special-function probes with separate source-free consumers and exact matching package SHA.
Close S01-T1-R/G/V and T1 only in accepted backlog/native DWF plan; S01-T2, phase S01, sibling phases, parent C03 and M6 gates remain unfinished.
